name: San Diego Summer 2019

venue.name: [Mount Everest Academy](https://www.sandiegounified.org/schools/mt-everest-academy)
venue.address: 4350 Mt. Everest Blvd. San Diego, CA 92117

information:
* **BEFORE REGISTRATION** please be aware of [competitor responsibilities.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SanDiegoSummer2019#11427-competitor-responsibilities)
* The competition will take place on Saturday, August 31st in the auditorium of Mount Everest Academy (https://www.sandiegounified.org/schools/mt-everest-academy/map-campus).
* Spectating is free and open to the public. Photography and videography are permitted, however there shall be **NO FLASH PHOTOGRAPHY**.
* Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years - thanks!
* If any changes are made to the competition or schedule, they will be clearly announced to all competitors in an email
* **Schedule is tentative to change at the discretion of the organization team**
